paite: Huan kei ka hihleh, Mid mi Darias akum khatna kum in, amah hihkip ding leh hihhat ding in ka dingh hi.
heading: Aigupta Leh Siria Lalgam
english: “As for me, in the first year of Darius the Mede, I stood up to confirm and strengthen him.

paite: Huchi in thutak ka hon ensak ding hi. "Ngai in, Persia ah kumpipa thum ahong dingkhe lai ding ua; alina pen amaute tengteng sang in nakpitak in ahausazaw ding hi. Huchi a ahauhna ziak a ahong hat mahmah chiang in, Grik dou ding in mi tengteng atokthou ding hi.
english: Now will I show you the truth. Behold, there shall stand up yet three kings in Persia; and the fourth shall be far richer than they all: and when he has grown strong through his riches, he shall stir up all against the realm of Greece.

paite: Huan kumpipa hattak ahong dingkhe ding a, thuneihna thupi toh vaihawm ding leh adeihdan a hih ding in.
english: A mighty king shall stand up, who shall rule with great dominion, and do according to his will.

paite: Ahong dinkhiak chiang in agam akek ding a, van huih lite lam ah hawmzak ahi ding; amah suan hilou in vai ahawm ding a, himahleh ama'n thilhihtheihna anei kei ding; agam bohkhiak leh midangte kiang ah piak in a-om ding hi.
english: When he shall stand up, his kingdom shall be broken, and shall be divided toward the four winds of the sky, but not to his posterity, nor according to his dominion with which he ruled; for his kingdom shall be plucked up, even for others besides these.

paite: "Huchi in simlam kumpipa ahat ding a, asepaih heutu khat amah sang in ahatzaw ding a, gam anei ding a; avaihawmna thupi ahi ding.
english: The king of the south shall be strong, and one of his princes; and he shall be strong above him, and have dominion; his dominion shall be a great dominion.

paite: Huan kum bangzah hiam nung in, akizomkhawm ding ua; simlam kumpipa tanu mallam kumpipa kiang ah kituahna bawl ding in ahong pai dia; himahleh hiai kizopna in hun sawt adaih kei ding; huai ni in amah veng mite leh apa leh amah kithuahpih pa leng piakkhiak in a-om ding hi.
english: At the end of years they shall join themselves together; and the daughter of the king of the south shall come to the king of the north to make an agreement: but she shall not retain the strength of her arm; neither shall he stand, nor his arm; but she shall be given up, and those who brought her, and he who became the father of her, and he who strengthened her in those times.

paite: "Himahleh azung a kipan ahiang selnou mun ah mi khat ahong dingkhe ding a; huai tuh sepaih pawl kiang ah ahong pai dia; mallam kumpipa kulhpi sung ah alut dia; amaute dou in thil ahih ding a, avualzou ding hi.
english: But out of a shoot from her roots shall one stand up in his place, who shall come to the army, and shall enter into the fortress of the king of the north, and shall deal against them, and shall prevail.

paite: Huchi in apathiante u leng, amilim sunte uh toh, huan adangka leh dangka-eng tui-um belsuan hoihte uh toh, Aigupta ah ama'n asal in alakik ding a; huan mallam kumpipa a kipan kum bangzah hiam akidangkoih ding hi.
english: Also their gods, with their molten images, and with their goodly vessels of silver and of gold, shall he carry captive into Egypt; and he shall refrain some years from the king of the north.

paite: Huan simlam kumpipa gam ah ahong pai dia, himahleh ama gam lam ah akik nawn ding hi.
english: He shall come into the realm of the king of the south, but he shall return into his own land.

paite: Huchi in atapate'n adou ding ua; sepaih thupi tampi akaikhawm ding ua; huaite adimlet in ahong kuan ding ua, apaisuak ding uh; huan akik nawn ding ua, amah kulh tanpha hial in adou ding uhi.
english: His sons shall war, and shall assemble a multitude of great forces, which shall come on, and overflow, and pass through; and they shall return and war, even to his fortress.

paite: Huchi in simlam kumpipa aheh mahmah ding a, ahong kuankhe dia mallam kumpipa akidoupih ding hi. Mallam kumpipa'n sepaih atam a tam tungkhe mahleh mipite akhut a piak in a-om ding uhi.
english: The king of the south shall be moved with anger, and shall come forth and fight with him, even with the king of the north; and he shall set forth a great multitude, and the multitude shall be given into his hand.

paite: Huan mipite pimang in a-om ding ua, alungtang sansak in a-om ding a; huchi in sing tampite apuksak ding a, himahleh avualzou kei ding hi.
english: The multitude shall be lifted up, and his heart shall be exalted; and he shall cast down tens of thousands, but he shall not prevail.

paite: "Huan mallam kumpipa ahong kik dia, ama sang a thupizaw mipi ahon tungkhe ding a; kum bangzah hiam nung in sepaihhon thupi leh van tampi toh ahong kuan ding hi.
english: The king of the north shall return, and shall set forth a multitude greater than the former; and he shall come on at the end of the times, even of years, with a great army and with much substance.

paite: Huan huai hunte ah simlam kumpipa dou in mi tampi adingkhe ding uh; na mite lak a hiamgam tate leng mengmuhna hihkip ding in ahong kidomkang ding ua; himahleh apuk ding uhi.
english: In those times there shall many stand up against the king of the south: also the children of the violent among your people shall lift themselves up to establish the vision; but they shall fall.

paite: Huchibang in mallam kumpipa ahong kisa dia, panmun abawl dia, khopi kulh neite ala ding; simlam sepaihte leh amitelte'n leng anang kei ding ua, nanna ding in hatna leng a-om kei ding hi.
english: So the king of the north shall come, and cast up a mound, and take a well-fortified city: and the forces of the south shall not stand, neither his chosen people, neither shall there be any strength to stand.

paite: Himahleh amah dou dia hong paipa'n ama deihlam bang in ahih ding a, ama ah kuamah adingh kei ding; gam thupi ah adingh dia, akhut ah siatna a-om ding hi.
english: But he who comes against him shall do according to his own will, and none shall stand before him; and he shall stand in the glorious land, and in his hand shall be destruction.

paite: Agam pumpi thahatna toh hong pai atum tinten ding a, simlam kumpigam toh kizopna bawl ding in atanu akiang ah ape ding hi; himahleh athil sawm alohsam ding a, aphattuampih sam kei ding.
english: He shall set his face to come with the strength of his whole kingdom, and with him equitable conditions; and he shall perform them: and he shall give him the daughter of women, to corrupt her; but she shall not stand, neither be for him.

paite: "Hiai khit in tuikulh lam anga dia, gam tampite azou ding hi; himahleh gamdangmi sepaih heutu khat in amah azou dia, ami simmohna atawpsak ding; ahi, ami simmohna amah tung ah akibungsak ding hi.
english: After this shall he turn his face to the islands, and shall take many: but a prince shall cause the reproach offered by him to cease; yes, moreover, he shall cause his reproach to turn on him.

paite: Huai hun chiang in ama gam kulhpi lam ah akik nawn dia; himahleh kisuipai in apuk dia, muh in a-om nawnta kei ding hi.
english: Then he shall turn his face toward the fortresses of his own land; but he shall stumble and fall, and shall not be found.

paite: Huai hun chiang in ama mun ah mi khat ahong dingkhe dia, ama'n agamsung puahna ding in leiman khonpa gam thupi tan apalsuaksak dia; himahleh ni tam lou zoh in hehna leh kidouna hilou in hihsiat in a-om ding hi.
english: Then shall stand up in his place one who shall cause a tax collector to pass through the kingdom to maintain its glory; but within few days he shall be destroyed, neither in anger, nor in battle.

paite: "Huan amun ah mizahpihhuai khat ahong dingkhe ding a, huai lalgam in zahtakna apiaklouhna pa uh; himahleh mite bit akisak lai un ahong pai dia, maitang phatna in gam ala ding hi.
heading: Siria Kumpipa Hoih Lou
english: In his place shall stand up a contemptible person, to whom they had not given the honor of the kingdom: but he shall come in time of security, and shall obtain the kingdom by flatteries.

paite: Huan sepaihhonte ama ah taihmang in a-om ding uh, thukhun heutupa tanpha tel in.
english: The overwhelming forces shall be overwhelmed from before him, and shall be broken; yes, also the prince of the covenant.

paite: Huchi in amah toh pankhawmna kibawl nung in lepchiahtak in thil ahih ding a; ahong kuantou dia, nam neuchik toh hong hat ding ahi.
english: After the treaty made with him he shall work deceitfully; for he shall come up, and shall become strong, with a small people.

paite: Gam khen a hausa mahmah namte abit lai pen un dou ding in akuantou dia, apipute'n ahihzoh louh uh ahon hihzou ding a, apipute'n leng ahih ngei louh uh alak uah samat leh gallakte leh vante ahawmzak dia, ahi, kulh nei khopite dou ding in aguksawm ding hi, himahleh hun khat kia adaih ding hi.
english: In time of security shall he come even on the fattest places of the province; and he shall do that which his fathers have not done, nor his fathers’ fathers; he shall scatter among them prey, and spoil, and substance: yes, he shall devise his devices against the strongholds, even for a time.

paite: "Huan sepaih thupi toh simlam kumpipa dou ding in athilhihtheihna leh ahatna atokthou ding a; huchi in simlam kumpipa'n sepaih athupi a thupi leh hat in kidouna ah adouthuk ding hi. Himahleh ama siatna ding a aguk a thusawm ahih ziak in adingh zou kei ding hi.
english: He shall stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army; and the king of the south shall war in battle with an exceeding great and mighty army; but he shall not stand; for they shall devise devices against him.

paite: Ahi, a-an nete'n amah ahihmang ding ua, asepaihte phiatmang in a-om ding uhi; huchi in tampi thah in apuk ding uhi.
english: Yes, they who eat of his dainties shall destroy him, and his army shall overflow; and many shall fall down slain.

paite: Kumpipa nihte ahih uleh gilou lungtang pu kawm in dohkan khat ah atukhawm ding ua, zuau in akikhemtuah ding uh. Himahleh hun tawp atung ding a sehsa ahih ziak in alohching kei ding uhi.
english: As for both these kings, their hearts shall be to do mischief, and they shall speak lies at one table: but it shall not prosper; for yet the end shall be at the time appointed.

paite: Huai hun chiang in simlam kumpipa tuh gallak thupi toh agam lam ah akik nawn dia; huchi in alungtang in thukhun siangthou adou ding; a-utut ahih ding a ama gam ngei ah akik nawn ding hi.
english: Then shall he return into his land with great substance; and his heart shall be against the holy covenant; and he shall do his pleasure, and return to his own land.

paite: "Hun sehsa ah akik nawn dia, simlam ah ahong pai dia; himahleh hun masa hiam hun nanung bang ahi kei ding hi.
english: At the time appointed he shall return, and come into the south; but it shall not be in the latter time as it was in the former.

paite: Amah dou dia Kittim longte hong pai ding ahih ziak in; huaiziak in adah ding a, akik nawn dia; thukhun siangthou dou in ahehna asungbo ding a a-utut ahih ding a; ahong kik nawn ngeingei dia, thukhun siangthou nungngatsante deihsakna alak ding hi.
english: For ships of Kittim shall come against him; therefore he shall be grieved, and shall return, and have indignation against the holy covenant, and shall do his pleasure: he shall even return, and have regard to those who forsake the holy covenant.

paite: Amah lam ah sepaihte apang ding ua, mun siangthou kulhpi mahmah abuahsak ding ua; halmang thillat gige ahihbei ding ua ahihgawp ding in kihhuai atungkhe ding uhi.
english: Forces shall stand on his part, and they shall profane the sanctuary, even the fortress, and shall take away the continual burnt offering , and they shall set up the abomination that makes desolate.

paite: Huan thukhun nungngatsante maitang phatna in giloutak in, ama'n ahekkawi dia; himahleh mi a Pathian uh theite bel ahat ding ua, thilhih minthangpente ahih ding uhi.
english: Such as do wickedly against the covenant shall he pervert by flatteries; but the people who know their God shall be strong, and do exploits .

paite: Huchi in mite lak a theihsiamna neite, ni tampi sung, namsau leh meikuang, saltanna leh siatna ah puk mah le uh, mi tampi athuhilh ding uhi.
english: Those who are wise among the people shall instruct many; yet they shall fall by the sword and by flame, by captivity and by spoil, many days.

paite: Huan apuk chiang un, panpihna tawmchik angah ding ua, himahleh maitang phatnate toh mi tampi in amau apawlbawl ding uhi.
english: Now when they shall fall, they shall be helped with a little help; but many shall join themselves to them with flatteries.

paite: Alak ua theihsiamna neite lak a mi khenkhatte, amaute bawlhoih ding leh siangthousak ding leh amaute ngousak ding in, apuk ding uhi. Hun tawp tanpha; hun sehsa a ding ahih lai ziak in.
english: Some of those who are wise shall fall, to refine them, and to purify, and to make them white, even to the time of the end; because it is yet for the time appointed.

paite: "Huan kumpipa'n adeihlam bang in ahih dia; akiliansak ding a, pathian chiteng tung ah akikoih lian dia, pathiante' Pathian dem in thillamdangte agen ding hi; thangpaihna apichin matan alohching ding; atup tintensa ahih ding hi.
english: The king shall do according to his will; and he shall exalt himself, and magnify himself above every god, and shall speak marvelous things against the God of gods; and he shall prosper until the indignation be accomplished; for that which is determined shall be done.

paite: Apipute pathiante leh numeite lunggulh leng azahtak kei dia, pathian leng azahtak kei ding; mi tengteng tung ah akiliansak ding hi.
english: Neither shall he regard the gods of his fathers, nor the desire of women, nor regard any god; for he shall magnify himself above all.

paite: Himahleh ama'n kulhpite pathian apahtawi dia; api-le-pute theih ngei louh dangka-eng leh dangka leh suangmantamte leh thilthawnpiak manphate in amah abe ding hi.
english: But in his place shall he honor the god of fortresses; and a god whom his fathers didn’t know shall he honor with gold, and silver, and with precious stones, and pleasant things.

paite: Huan gamdang pathiante panpihna in kulh muanhuaipen pente asual ding a; kuapeuh amah hihna pomte kiang ah zahna lianzaw ape ding a, tampi tung a vaihawm ding in abawl dia, man nei in gam ahawm ding hi.
english: He shall deal with the strongest fortresses by the help of a foreign god: whoever acknowledges him he will increase with glory; and he shall cause them to rule over many, and shall divide the land for a price.

paite: "Huan hun tawp chiang in simlam kumpipa'n amah akidoupih ding; mallam kumpipa amah dou ding in pingpei bang in, kangtalaite toh, sakol tungtuang mite toh, long tampi toh ahong kuan ding; huchi in gamte ah alut dia, adimlet dia apaisuak ding hi.
english: At the time of the end shall the king of the south contend with him; and the king of the north shall come against him like a whirlwind, with chariots, and with horsemen, and with many ships; and he shall enter into the countries, and shall overflow and pass through.

paite: Ama'n gam siangthoupen leng asim ding a, huchi in gam tampi zoh in a-om ding hi; himahleh Edom leh Moab leh Ammon tate hausapate akhut a kipan suahtaksak in a-om ding hi.
english: He shall enter also into the glorious land, and many countries shall be overthrown; but these shall be delivered out of his hand: Edom, and Moab, and the chief of the children of Ammon.

paite: Gam tampite tung ah akhut azan ding a; Aigupta gam asuakta kei ding hi.
english: He shall stretch forth his hand also on the countries; and the land of Egypt shall not escape.

paite: Himahleh dangka-eng leh dangka goute tung leh Aigupta thil manphate tengteng tung ah thilhihtheihna anei dia; huan Libia mite leh Ethiopia mite akalsuanna ah a-om ding uhi.
english: But he shall have power over the treasures of gold and of silver, and over all the precious things of Egypt; and the Libyans and the Ethiopians shall be at his steps.

paite: "Himahleh suahlam a kipan leh mallam a kipan a thuthang in amah ahihlau dia; thangpaihna thupi a mi tampi hihse ding leh hihmang ding in akuankhe ding hi.
english: But news out of the east and out of the north shall trouble him; and he shall go forth with great fury to destroy and utterly to sweep away many.

paite: Huan tuipi leh tang siangthou thupi kikal ah a-inpi puaninte akai ding a, himahleh amah abeina hong tung dia, kuamah in amah apanpih kei ding uh."
english: He shall plant the tents of his palace between the sea and the glorious holy mountain; yet he shall come to his end, and none shall help him.
